subject: Judge: review backend config + endpoint + drain-routing + hard-block
description: Single-attempt code review (self-learn-judge review mode) of the config-routing attempt branch. Fetch the attempt diff (get_attempt_diff) and apply the rubric: (1) overlay.config.backend persists correctly; (2) GET/POST /config/backend works — GET reports listProviders() with detected isAvailable/isAuthed per provider, POST sets+persists the config; (3) the judge drain in headless-drain.js now routes through getActiveBackend(overlay).buildInvocation (not the hardcoded Claude path), and an 'api'-kind active backend skips cleanly (does NOT call the throwing stub); (4) HARD-BLOCK: runDueDrains returns skipped:'no_backend' when no valid backend, no crash; (5) ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS still default-OFF + the fire-rate backoff untouched; tests cover all; scope excludes dashboard UI / real API impl / Codex+Cursor. Under the feature, APPROVE auto-merges the attempt into the feature branch (merge_attempt, auto-aborts on conflict); KICK BACK = set_status failed + a wired record_decision. NEVER force-merge.
